text:
rachel: noticing a small but consistent gap between the Console version badge and actual routed model for some tenants — e.g. badge shows v2 but routing trace shows redwood-v1. This is leading to confused quota alerts. anyone dug into why the badge differs?

 tom: console badge is driven by fastpath event (client header) for realtime responsiveness. routing decisions are emitted later, so if router falls back we get divergence.

 ina: we've seen this on sequences that trigger model fallbacks (seq_len, quantization mismatch). router often decides post-fastpath. two options: delay badge until router decision (adds latency) or attach a confidence flag to the badge.

 carlos: leaning toward adding an "attribution_source" and "confidence" attribute to console events. keep fastpath for realtime, but show a low-confidence visual until router confirms. reduces churn and avoids changing billing logic.

 rachel: agree. for billing we must be precise: billing should rely on router/executor fields when available. we can't have invoices based on client header. but for UX, confidence overlay is neat.

 tom: implementation sketch: 1) modify fastpath event to include attribution_hint=client_version 2) router emits route_decision with attributed_model and reason 3) console joins events by req_id in a 10s window and computes confidence score: 1.0 exec match, 0.8 router match, 0.4 header-only. join is best-effort for realtime UI but we also run batch reconciliation.

 ina: perf note: full join at peak QPS is heavy. do shadow join for 1% of traffic first and sample 5% for the reconciliation job. If results stable, scale up.

 carlos: reconciliation output: CSV with tenant, old_tokens, new_tokens, pct_delta, top_examples. legal wants audit logs and a preview step before any invoice changes.

 infra-bot: perf-sim scheduled: "attr-join-shadow" on 2025-06-16T03:00Z, duration 60m. Results will be posted to #eng-platform.

 rachel: next steps: tom opens PR for event schema (attribution_hint + confidence field stub), ina builds shadow join and perf sim, carlos drafts reconciliation + legal runbook and UI copy. we'll review after perf run and plan a 1-tenant cohort shadow.

 tom: will add a console toggle: "Show only high-confidence attribution" so operators can avoid noisy slices.

 rachel: thanks team. let's aim for a safe rollout path: UI confidence first, billing reconciliation dry-run, then opt-in invoice corrections. post PR links here. :thumbsup:
